Commentary.Commentary: Right. That is all we have from this game. Sri Lanka will be pleased with this display and will look to wrap the series up in the next game, whereas, South Africa will look to bounce back. The second ODI will be played on Saturday, 04th September 2021 at 2.30 pm local (9 am GMT). You can tune in early for the buildup. Cheers!

Dasun Shanka, the Sri Lankan skipper, says this win was really pleasing. Mentions South Africa came into the game well but his bowlers did really well to take off the pressure. Adds that everyone contributed well and they built several partnerships in the middle which is a good sign. Also says he expected the ball to turn in the evening, but that was not the case. Adds they knew it is very hard to chase on this pitch and they were quite happy by putting up 300 on the board.

Keshav Maharaj (stepping up for Temba Bavuma, who got injured) says that the skipper Bavuma has gone for a scan of his fingers and hopes he is fine and comes back early. Adds he just tried to concentrate and luckily enough it worked in his favour. Mentions they had a really good preparation coming into this game. Praises his batters as they fought hard but in the end, praises the Sri Lankan bowlers for their effort.

Avishka Fernando is the Player of the Match for his excellent effort with the bat and getting his third ODI ton. He says that he was determined and happy that they won. He was not happy early on with his innings but he made sure he grew into his innings. Adds that he is very happy to contribute to the team.
... Stay tuned for the Presentation ...

Earlier in the day, Sri Lanka decided to post a total for the visitors as they chose to bat first. They started well and kept the scoreboard ticking throughout the course of the innings. Avishka Fernando was the star for them, as the youngster smacked a wonderful 118 and he was well supported by Charith Asalanka and Dhananjaya de Silva as their knocks helped Sri Lanka post a great total of 300. In the end, their bowlers backed up their solid batting display and that sees them take a lead in this series.

The bowling by Sri Lanka was good at the start, but they lost their way slightly in the middle overs as they were not able to sniff out the Saffa batters, but they bounced back at the right time towards the end of the game and have taken their side home. They took a wicket early on but found it hard after that and when Bavuma went back due to his finger injury, they saw that the door was ajar and slipped in. They took a couple of wickets post that and bowled very well to close the game out. It was about the spinners for them too, as Akila Dananjaya, Wanindu Hasaranga, Praveen Jayawickrama, and Dhananjaya de Silva bowled well and shared 4 amongst themselves. The pacers did not have a lot to do on this deck, but they wrapped the game up nicely, towards the end.

Rassie van der Dussen took charge after that and after Kyle Verreynne departed, Rassie and Heinrich Klaasen did well to steady the ship and settle in, as they also raised a 51-run stand, wherein Rassie also reached his fifty and they looked like they would take their team over the line, but Rassie departed at the wrong time and Sri Lanka knew they could sniff the visitors out of the game now. Klaasen tried hard to find the boundary and take his team over the line, but it was not meant to be as they missed out by 14 runs.

When you are chasing a total of 300 in a game, you need your openers to start off nicely so that the atmosphere in the camp is good and positive and that is what Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram did. They batted well and the scoreboard was ticking nicely too. Malan fell towards the end of Powerplay 1, but the duo of Aiden Markram and Temba Bavuma batted very well. They did well to keep rotating the strike and when needed, they would find the boundary too. They were going along nicely before Bavuma was struck on the finger from a throw and he had to retire hurt. Markram looked to be in control too, but on 96, he looked for a big shot and ended up giving a catch to Hasaranga, who needed no second invitation.
A length ball, on off. Maharaj pushes it to cover but straight to the fielder. Sri Lanka win by 14 runs. They take a 1-0 lead in the series.

Wow, what a game this has been! It has gone right down to the wire and it is Sri Lanka, who come out as the superior side, as they win this game by 14 runs and take a 1-0 lead in this 3-game ODI series. South Africa will be a tad disappointed to miss out on this game as they knew that they had this game in their grasp, but have not been able to cross the line and would look to bounce back in their next clash.

Fuller on middle, Heinrich Klaasen gets low and sweeps this hard to deep square leg. The man there runs to his left and stops the ball and saves two for his side.
Tossed up, on middle, this is reverse-swept to the point fielder.

Full toss on middle, swept to the left of short fine leg, who dives that side and stops the ball really well. One run, in the end.
Around off, nudged through mid-wicket for one.
This time, he connects with his sweep and sends it to deep square leg for one.

Review! Dasun Shanaka sends it upstairs for a review for LBW. The on-field decision is not out. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows that it is umpire's call when the ball hits the wickets. The on-field decision stands. Sri Lanka does not lose a review here.

NOT OUT! Rassie van der Dussen is saved by umpire's call. Tossed up, landing around off and middle, spins away as van der Dussen moves away and looks to work this to the leg side. He misses and gets hit on this thigh. An appeal but the umpire turns it down. He probably thinks that the impact is outside off. Shanaka wants to have this one checked and he goes for the review. UltraEdge shows that the bat had no part to play in this. Ball Tracker shows that the impact was not an issue, as it was in line, but it is umpire's call on wickets and hence, this will be not out.

Floated on off, defended out.

DRINKS BREAK. This has been a good start to the run chase by South Africa. Yes, they did lose Malan towards the end of Powerplay 1, but the duo of Bavuma and Markram has weathered the storm and would look to continue. Sri Lanka have bowled well so far, but have not tasted a lot of success, in terms of wickets. If they can snare a couple of wickets now, the pressure will be on the Saffas. 207 more needed in 198 balls and this game could go either way. Should be an interesting phase of play.
A length ball, on off. Markram defends it out solidly.

A full-length ball, on off. Bavuma pushes it to mid off. He takes off for a quick single. The fielder at mid off comes charging in towards the ball but could not collect it. Bavuma is safe. That was a really risky run.
Full and on off. Markram taps it to point. They take one.
A length ball, on the pads. Bavuma stays back and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On leg, Markram defends it out watchfully.
On middle. Markram stays back and tucks it through mid-wicket. The batters pick two without any trouble.
FOUR! Nicely played. A low full toss and on off. Markram hammers it past mid off. The ball races away to the boundary.
Quicker. Full and on off. Markram punches it to cover, but straight to the fielder.
On the pads. Bavuma flicks it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Markram works it towards mid on for a single.
5 off the over! Fuller-ball, on off, worked to long on for one.
Around off, length, pushed to sweeper cover for one.
WIDE. Dasun serves a short ball to his opposite skipper, Temba looks to upper cut this but pulls out of the shot. Wide signalled.
Outside off on a length, some gently away movement, Aiden pushes this to mid off and they scamper through for the single.
Around off, on a length, pushed straight to the mid on fielder.
Good-length ball on off, this is softly pushed to the mid on region. Temba Bavuma comes out, looking for a run, but is sent back.
Width offered outside off, slapped behind point for a single.
Dasun Shanaka comes into the attack now.
Around off, worked through covers for a single.
Temba Bavuma has just watchfully blocked this out.
This is pushed to covers.

That is very, very well bowled by Akila. This is the leg-spinner, on leg and it straightens, Bavuma looks to flick this to the leg side but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the right of first slip, Dhananjaya de Silva, who moves that side, but the ball goes past him and onto the ground.
Darted on the pads, Aiden Markram moves to the leg side and bunts this through mid on. Rotates the strike.
Akila starts with a short ball around off, Bavuma works this through backward point for one.
Akila Dananjaya comes into the attack now.
Full toss, around off and middle, played to long off for one.
Slower through the air, on middle and leg, nudged to the on side.
Flatter around off, Aiden punches to long off. One more run.
Shortish on off, Temba goes back and pushes this to covers for one.
Dragged shorter again, around off, punched to long on for one.
The arm ball, darted on the pads, easily clipped by Temba to deep square leg for one.
Around middle, turned around the corner on the on side for one. 6 singles from this over!
This is milked nicely to the fielder at long off for one more.
Floats it up, on off, tapped to point. One more run.
Outside off, slightly short, punched to sweeper cover for one.
On middle, hit hard to long on for one.
Gives this one air, lands it around off, stroked to covers, where Shanaka dives and half-stops the ball. One run.
A touch short, around off, punched through covers for one.
Tosses this one up, outside off, eased through covers for one.
Floated, fuller on off, Temba works this one back to the bowler.
This is pushed through covers for a single.
SIX! That was very well hit. This is bowled fuller, around off, Aiden Markram dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and bangs this one over long on.
Around middle, Aiden presses forward and defends this one out.
BEATEN! Loopy ball, around off. This one turns away. Bavuma prods and looks to defend it out but misses. The ball beats the outside edge. A wicket maiden for Wanindu Hasaranga.
On off, Bavuma defends it out solidly.

OUT! LBW! Wanindu Hasaranga does the trick for Sri Lanka and finds the first breakthrough. Wanindu Hasaranga serves a googly on off. Malan goes back and looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Wanindu Hasaranga and company put in an appeal. Janneman Malan walks off, even before the umpire raises his finger. This was beautifully bowled. Malan could not do anything about it.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
Tossed up, on off. Malan punches it to cover.
Full and on middle. Malan looks to sweep it away but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards short fine leg.
Out walks the skipper, Temba Bavuma!
Tossed up, on off. Malan hits it hard back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. Markram defends it out watchfully.
Floated full and on off. Markram defends it out with a striaght bat.
On off, Markram works it towards long on.
Low full toss and on off. Malan hangs back and slashes it hard towards cover. The fielder gets a hand on it, to make a half stop. The batters take a single.
Tossed up, on middle. This one turns away. Malan defends it out solidly.
Flighted full and on off. Markram punches it through cover. The batters pick three, before the fielder cuts it out.
Change. Praveen Jayawickrama to roll his arm now!
Loopy ball, on off. Markram defends it to cover for a single.
On off, Markram pushes it out.

Markram survives an LBW appeal! The review does not work out for the Lankans, even though they retain it. Googly around off. Markram prods and looks to sweep it away but misses. He gets hit on his thigh pad, on the back leg. Hasaranga puts in an appeal but the umpire says no. Dasun Shanaka decides to take it upstairs. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows there is umpire's call on impact, even though the ball would go onto hit the wickets. Markram does not have to walk back as the on-field decision stands.
A touch short, outside off. Markram looks to cut it away but misses.
Loopy ball, outside off. Markram comes across and looks to sweep it away but misses. The ball goes onto hit him on the pads.
Googly, full and on off. Malan looks to push it to the off side. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg. The batters take a quick single.
SIX! All the way! Markram connected it really well. A short ball, on off. Markram hangs back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum. A good end to the over for South Africa.
A length ball, on off. Malan stays back and guides it towards third man for a single.
Short ball and on off. Malan hangs back and looks to pull it away but misses.
EDGY! A full-length ball, around off. Markram looks to defend it out. He manages to get an outside edge. The ball goes towards third man. The batters take a single.
FOUR! Played it nicely. On a length, around off. Markram hangs back and punches it with strong hands past mid off. The timing on the shot is so good that the ball races away to the boundary.
A length ball, on off. This one is close to the body. Malan plays it towards mid off. The batters get a single.
Short and outside off. Markram stays inside the crease and pushes it to point but cannot find the gap.
Darted on the pads. Markram taps it to the leg side.
Full and on off. Markram prods and defends it out solidly.
Loopy ball, on off. Markram swings hard. The ball goes towards square leg off the inner half.
Floated, around off. Malan hangs back and punches it to long off. They take one.
Flighted, full and on off. Malan goes back and pushes it to cover.
Spin time! Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack.
Back of a length, on off, kept out by Aiden.
Outside off, punched to point.
FOUR! Markram gets a boundary now. This is pitched up, around the off pole, slight bit of away movement, as Aiden Markram whips this through mid-wicket.
Short of a length, on off and middle, played nicely to the mid on region by Markram.
On a fullish length, on middle, whipped towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Attacks the sticks with a length delivery, Aiden pushes this to the off side.
11 from the over! On a length around off, Malan's punch finds the cover fielder again.
Janneman Malan has just blocked that from his crease.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Well played by Malan again. Shortish, outside off, Janneman Malan dances down and slaps this one over point for a boundary.
Around off, length, worked to the point fielder.
FOUR! SHOT! A shot of authority from Malan. On a length, around off, this is punched sweetly through covers for a boundary.
On a length, around off, Aiden Markram slams this through covers. The man there dives and half-stops this. Dasun Shanaka chases after the ball and stops it near the ropes. Three taken.
This is pushed to the point fielder.
WIDE! A very short ball, on middle, Malan just watches it go over him to the keeper. Wide called by the umpire for height.
An outswinger outside off, Malan leaves it be.
A bouncer on middle and leg, JM ducks under this one.
Around off, pushed to the man at covers.
Fullish this time, around off, this is worked nicely past the mid on fielder. The man gives it a chase and stops the ball. A couple.
On a length, on off, punched straight to Avishka Fernando at point this time.
Aiden Markram has just blocked that from his crease.
Around off on a length, hit straight to the mid on fielder.
Outside off, fourth stump channel, Malan shoulders arms.
Around middle, kept out.
Back of a length, outside off, Janneman Malan looks to punch this with a straight bat through covers, but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the third man region. One run.
WIDE. Way too outside off, length, Malan leaves it. Wide signalled.
Length around off, punched to the cover fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end with the second new ball? It is going to be Chamika Karunaratne.
A single to end the over! Around off, punched to the right of mid off. The man there dives to his left and pushes the ball away, as the batters take the run.
Back of a length, outside off, Janneman Malan steers this one through point. Two taken by the time Wanindu Hasaranga can chase after this and stop the ball.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Malan.
In the zone of uncertainty, outside off, length, Janneman Malan looks to poke at this but gets beaten.

EDGY FOUR! Janneman Malan is off the mark in a streaky manner. South Africa are on their way. On a length, around off, the ball lands and seams away late. Malan looks to defend but the ball catches the outside edge and runs away past the slip cordon for a boundary.
Dushmantha Chameera starts with a short-of-a-length delivery around off, Janneman Malan hops and taps this to the point region.
